summary: OKKAX end-to-end backend + frontend smoke testing. Wrote 27 pytest cases covering auth, RBAC, event studio + blueprint (with async refine), talent/rider, venue matches, sponsor flow (interest -> approval -> budget update), tenant flow (apply -> approve), ticketing (VA + QRIS), sandbox payment success + failure, refund, QR validation (Valid/Already Used/Invalid), budget engine + simulator, discover + public event, admin metrics/users/orgs/audit-logs. All 27 pass after fixing a critical MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug in several POST endpoints. Frontend smoke test: login (all demo accounts reachable), public event page, checkout with VA + BCA channel + paylater disabled correctly, create_order -> simulate_pay -> ticket issued (OKX-TIX-000005), validator: Valid then Already Used. Discover + tickets list render with correct data.

minor.issue: Motor mutates dict passed to insert_one adding ObjectId `_id`, then FastAPI fails to serialize -> 500. FIXED by wrapping returned docs with clean(). Also fixed all other endpoints returning newly-inserted docs (create_zone, create_tier, create_package, event vendor/job/worker, budget/funding items, schedule/incidents).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Extend clean() usage pattern to any future POST endpoints that return the newly-inserted document; motor mutates the original dict with ObjectId `_id`. Consider a small helper insert_and_clean() to prevent regressions.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1701 lines — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, events.py, ticketing.py, sponsors.py, tenants.py, admin.py) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
MongoDB ObjectId leak was systemic: any `await db.<coll>.insert_one(doc); return {..: doc}` will 500. Adopt an insert_and_return helper. Fixed >10 sites in this run.
Blueprint refine background task uses asyncio.create_task without any tracking; if backend restarts mid-refine the event stays at 'refining'. Acceptable for MVP but worth noting.
`db.events.find(f)` on discover doesn't apply price filter for min-price sort; the free filter works. Minor.
`/api/auth/forgot-password` returns demo_token in body — correctly noted as demo/sandbox only.

rca of the issue: Critical bug fixed: motor's insert_one() mutates the input dict by inserting an ObjectId under '_id'. Endpoints that returned that same dict caused FastAPI serialization to explode with `TypeError: 'ObjectId' object is not iterable`. This affected POST /talents, /checkout, /sponsor-interests, /tenant-applications, /orders/{id}/refund, tickets returned by /payments/{id}/simulate, and several catalog/booth/tier/zone/job/worker/budget/schedule/incident inserts. Reproduction: `POST /api/checkout` with valid audience token -> 500 with stack trace showing ObjectId encoder failure. Mitigation applied: wrap returned doc in `clean()` (removes _id + sensitive fields).
